question: Which of the following oxides corresponds to the oxide of Eka-aluminium?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Eka-aluminum:

__
 
• This is the name given by Mendeleev to the undiscovered element.
 
• This element presently exists by the name of Gallium.
 
• Gallium belongs to group 13 of the periodic table.
 
• Its atomic number is 31.
 
• It's a soft, silvery metal at standard temperature and pressure.
 
• Ga2O₃ corresponds to the oxide of Eka-aluminium.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Oxides:

 
• These are chemical compounds with one or more oxygen atoms combined with another element.
 
• Oxides are binary compounds of oxygen with another element, e.g., CO2, SO2, CaO, CO, ZnO, BaO2, H2O, etc.
 
 
• Acidic Oxide: An oxide that combines with water to give an acid is termed an acidic oxide.
 
• Basic Oxide: The oxide that gives a base in water is known as a basic oxide.
 
• Amphoteric solution: It's a solution that can chemically react as either acid or base.
 
• Neutral Oxide: It is also possible for an oxide to be neither acidic nor basic, but is a neutral oxide.
